common_update_authority.claim: bounded common update object established; named algorithms not derived by that witness

rows.name: gradient descent specialization
rows.loses_when: gradient is unavailable/uninformative or derivative burden exceeds saved search

rows.name: reverse/local credit assignment specialization
rows.object: forward primal graph plus reverse adjoint propagation
rows.loses_when: matched forward/local directional derivative burden is lower for the registered graph/output structure

rows.name: Bayesian updating specialization
rows.object: posterior proportional to likelihood times prior; Bayes action under declared loss
rows.loses_when: model is misspecified for the protected obligation or inference/belief maintenance costs more than its decision value

rows.name: exemplar-memory update specialization
rows.object: retained example insertion plus registered retrieval/index and emitter
rows.loses_when: a stable compact sufficient representation beats storage/retrieval/revision burden

rows.name: symbolic rule induction specialization
rows.object: verified transformations over a declared reusable rule/hypothesis language
rows.loses_when: no compact reusable discrete structure exists, exact-rule noise/inconsistency dominates, or revision exceeds reuse

rows.name: program/library learning specialization
rows.object: verified reusable abstraction installed when future search savings exceed acquisition plus maintenance
rows.loses_when: reuse is too small or enlarged-grammar branching cost exceeds compression/search-depth savings

rows.name: evolutionary population update specialization
rows.object: population/proposal distribution plus variation, evaluation and selection update
rows.loses_when: an informative cheaper derivative/model channel exists or useful-successor proposal support is negligible

rows.name: meta-learning / learned optimizer specialization
rows.object: object update U_phi plus slower update of meta-state phi across tasks
rows.loses_when: future tasks are too few/dissimilar or meta acquisition, maintenance and negative transfer exceed future savings

rows.name: self-modification / morphology-update specialization
rows.object: verified developmental transition may change morphology and/or update law
rows.loses_when: short horizon or search, migration, verification, regression and revision costs exceed future savings

rows.name: quantify when each law is cheaper
rows.object: hard-budget feasibility followed by Pareto comparison or frozen-price lifecycle minimization
rows.loses_when: not applicable; this is the common comparison criterion

rows.name: negative ecology where each law loses
rows.object: one explicit structural/resource losing regime registered for every named family
rows.loses_when: not applicable; this row is the losing-regime registry

prospective_rows.name: neutral recovery of at least two qualitatively different learning laws
prospective_rows.required_evidence: identity-hidden neutral grammar/search, full search burden, post-search classification, negative twin, disjoint replication

prospective_rows.name: predict learning-law class for held-out ecology before search
prospective_rows.required_evidence: pre-outcome architecture-name-free descriptor and class/phase prediction, frozen score/falsifier, protected outcome

terminal_rules: Mechanism rediscovery terminates PARENT_SUFFICIENT unless a resource/predictive residual survives.
Formal losing conditions are not substitutes for running preregistered negative ecologies when prospective evidence is claimed.
No universal best learning law is implied.
Section C complete empirical closure remains NOT_EARNED while C13 or C14 is open.
